newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank Canada completes Richardson deal.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank Canada completes Richardson deal.

text.p: Royal Bank of Canada said on Friday that its brokerage unit RBC Dominion Securities completed its C$480 million acquisition of investment dealer Richardson Greenshields of Canada Ltd.
"It has closed as of today for C$480 million," Royal Bank spokesman Paul Wilson said in a telephone interview.
"Everything is moving ahead very smoothly. The full integration will take several months to complete, primarily on the retail and bank office side," Wilson said.
He said most of the trading operations had already been merged.
The merged company will be known as RBC DS Global Markets and employ about 1600 investment advisors, Wilson said.
Royal Bank announced the merger with Richardson Greenshields, one of Canada's few independent investment dealers, in August.

Since then rumors have swirled around Midland Walwyn Inc, the country's last big independent dealer. But Midland officials insisted on Tuesday that it was not for sale and suggested the probability of a hostile takeover was low.
"The fact is we are not for sale. We are fully committed to independence," said Midland chief executive Robert Schultz.
